brand.name: Stripe
brand.category: Financial infrastructure and payment processing platform
brand.summary: Stripe provides a comprehensive suite of financial tools for businesses of all sizes to accept payments, manage billing, and handle money movement globally. It offers integrated solutions for online and in-person transactions, fraud prevention, and platform-based financial services.
